verdict.rationale: Warp's own docs say users can customize fonts as part of its visual appearance settings, so basic font selection is a first-party capability. Nothing in the evidence covers ligatures, fallback font chains, or fine-grained tuning such as size, line height, weight, or spacing. missing for 10: ligature support evidence, fallback font configuration, fine-grained font tuning controls (line height/weight/spacing), independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can use programming fonts with ligatures, fallback fonts, and fine-grained font tuning

citations.quote: Customize Warp's visual appearance, including themes, fonts, prompts, app icons, input position, and pane behavior.
